newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FPB Bank Holding unit to launch FRCD.
newsitem.headline: FPB Bank Holding unit to launch FRCD.

text.p: First Pacific Bank Ltd, a unit of FPB Bank Holding Co Ltd, will launch a multi-tranche floating rate certificates of deposit (FRCD) issue shortly, bankers said.
The certificates will be available in either Hong Kong or U.S. dollars.
Bankers said the issue size is expected to be HK$500 million or its equivalent in U.S. dollars. It will carry a maturity of five years with put and call options in years three and four.
Standard Chartered Bank, Westdeutsche Landesbank, Bayerische Landesbank and CS First Boston are the mandated arrangers for the deal.
First Pacific Bank completed a US$52 million equivalent two currency FRCD last November.
The five-year issue also had put and call options in year three and four. It consisted of a HK$270 million tranche and a US$17 million tranche.

It paid an all-in return of 106 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate for the Hong Kong dollar tranche and 87 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate for the U.S. dollar tranche.
